sentences.en: Calmness and tranquility are all I need to work well.
sentences.zh: 宁静和安静是我工作所需的全部。

sentences.en: The city was restored to tranquility after a week.
sentences.zh: 一周后，这座城市恢复了平静。

sentences.en: The small town of Taghit, in southwestern Algeria, enjoys an enviable tranquility.
sentences.zh: 位于阿尔及利亚西南部的塔吉特小镇享有难以匹敌的宁静。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：tranquil（宁静的）+ity（表名词）→宁静
